steps: The potential at the surface of the sphere is V(R) = kQ/R = 16 V.
The potential inside a uniformly charged sphere at distance r is V(r) = (kQ / 2R^3) * (3R^2 - r^2).
For point P at r = R/2, V(P) = (kQ / 2R^3) * (3R^2 - R^2/4) = 11kQ / 8R.
The potential outside the sphere at distance r is V(r) = kQ/r.
For point S at r = 2R, V(S) = kQ / 2R.
The potential difference is V(P) - V(S) = (11kQ / 8R) - (4kQ / 8R) = 7kQ / 8R = (7/8) * 16 = 14 V.
